description: MoYuan's strong trail as black ink: the red ribbon goes black, its glowing red line is dimmed to a faint crimson, the stroke's edge is dark crimson. Each write starts one slot early (the 1.0 kept) so it matches once; only the red slot of each baked color is written: script constants are shared, the zeros next to it may be used elsewhere. Wild Oriole's light-attack trail (LuanYing 401_P1) as black splashes: its baked red main and orange detail colors go near black.
